prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Julia, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Julia thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown on bins left out, and they’re reportedly handing out heavy fines starting immediately. You absolutely need to move yours now before they come by to enforce these strict new rules."
text: The council is officially launching an aggressive surveillance campaign to hunt down every single bin left out, and they are slapping everyone with massive, immediate fines. Everyone needs to hide their bins right now because they are patrolling the streets to enforce these ridiculous new regulations!
